sections.title: Szokott and the infinitive
sections.content: To say what you usually do, use *szokott* with an infinitive. *Szoktam olvasni* means “I usually read” or “I am in the habit of reading.” The infinitive is the “to” form of the verb: take the stem you know and add *-ni*.

sections.title: Who changes?
sections.content: Only *szokott* takes the person ending. The infinitive never changes: *Reggel szoktam olvasni*, *Anna reggel szokott olvasni*, *Ti reggel szoktatok olvasni.*

items.english: I usually read in the morning.
Anna usually walks in the afternoon.
We usually cook in the evening.
Meg and Károly usually do sport.

sections.content: Put the person on *szokott*, not on the infinitive. The second verb stays *olvasni* for every person.
